description:
U by Urbeo proudly presents U Citywest Quarter, ideally located in the heart of Citywest with exceptional transport links and everyday amenities on your doorstep.

Key Features:

- A rated energy efficient apartments
- Spacious, expertly designed layouts
- Interiors by Ventura Living with bespoke U furniture
- Fully fitted kitchens with integrated appliances and separate utility room
- Bright living areas with private balconies overlooking landscaped courtyards
- Upper floors with stunning Dublin Mountains views
- High energy efficiency

Resident Amenities:

- Residents’ amenity space
- Multi-function activity room
- Dedicated on-site management team
- Bringme parcel management service

Transport Links:

- Citywest Luas Red Line stop on your doorstep (every 10 minutes to City Centre & Tallaght)
- Dublin Bus routes 65b, 77a & 175 nearby
- Excellent road connections to major routes

Location Highlights:

- Tesco Express at your doorstep
- Citywest Shopping Centre directly across the road (including Dunnes Stores)
- On site creche
- Walking distance to Scoil Aoife Primary School
- Close to Citywest & Saggart Community National School & Citywest Educate Together National School

*Our team will endeavour to respond to all enquiries. However, this may not be possible in all cases due to the high volume of interest for the property and we wish you all the best with your property search.*
